_purpose: Cross-repository conformance fixture for the Agora canonical-JSON-hash algorithm. The pantheon (Python, scripts/agora_compat_manifest.py::canonical_json_sha256) and execute-plans (JS, scripts/deploy-dev-vm.sh::canonicalize + sha256) implementations are independent reimplementations of the same rule: recursively sort object keys, JSON-encode compactly (no extra whitespace), append one literal LF byte, then SHA-256 the UTF-8 bytes. This fixture pins one concrete payload/hash pair so both sides' test suites assert against the same expected value instead of only checking self-consistency. If either implementation changes and this fixture's expected_sha256 no longer matches, that is the two repos' contracts silently diverging -- update this file in BOTH repos in the same change, with the algorithm rationale in the commit message, never as a routine bump.
